content.short: Veax is a DEX on NEAR Protocol offering capital-efficient liquidity and multiple fee levels.
content.description: Veax is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on the NEAR Protocol that aims to improve your DeFi experience by reducing capital requirements and trading costs. It achieves this through two core mechanisms: Concentrated Liquidity and Multiple Fee Levels. By concentrating liquidity within a defined price range, liquidity providers can earn higher profits with the same amount of liquidity as in traditional DEXes, delivering greater capital efficiency and cost savings for both traders and liquidity providers.
